written.headline: Microsoft AI diagnostic system hits 83% accuracy, over twice doctors in complex cases
written.summary: Microsoft’s Diagnostic Orchestrator (MAI‑DxO) correctly diagnosed complex medical cases 83% of the time in a simulation, compared with 36% for generalist physicians using reference materials. The system also outperformed doctors on emergency department cases, achieving about 80% accuracy versus roughly 47% for physicians.

written.headline: Uber expands ChatGPT Work to all 30,000 employees
written.summary: Uber is rolling out OpenAI’s ChatGPT Work, an AI office‑task agent, to its entire global workforce of about 30,000 staff. The tool, which connects to Gmail, Drive and Slack and runs on the GPT‑6.1 Sol model, will help employees research, analyze data, create presentations and automate workflows.

written.headline: Chinese hackers used AI agents to breach ConnectWise and access 2,250 Microsoft 365 tenants
written.summary: Microsoft says China‑aligned hackers stole ConnectWise cloud backup credentials and used the open‑source AI framework ARTEX to infiltrate about 2,250 organizations, attempting nearly 3,000 sign‑ins per minute. The attackers gained privileged cloud access in some cases within three hours.
